# Supporters

FlipDeFlock is free and stays that way. **Donations never gate a feature** — every
detection, every screen, and every signature is available to everyone, forever, under
GPL-3.0-or-later. That is a promise, not a marketing position.

Support funds development time, test hardware, and the legal costs that come with
mapping surveillance infrastructure.

## What supporters get

Recognition and access, never functionality:

- Your name or handle listed below, if you want it (say so when you sponsor — the
  default is to leave you off).
- Early access to release candidates before they're tagged. The source is public the
  whole time, so this is a time offset, not a gate — you can always build from `main`.
- Priority on board-support requests. If you're running an unusual ESP32 and it doesn't
  work, supporters go to the front of the queue.
- A supporters role once the Discord is up.

## What supporters do not get

- Features other users don't have.
- Detection signatures other users don't have. The signature database is the core value
  of a detector; paywalling it would mean paywalling safety.
- Influence over the project's principles. Passive recon only, precision over recall,
  and never over-claiming a detection are not for sale.

## Other ways to help

Honestly, these are worth more than money right now:

- **Field reports.** New Flock/ALPR OUIs, SSID patterns, and probe IE fingerprints from
  corroborated units — and equally, detections that *misfired*. See
  [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- **Board reports.** Tell us what ESP32 you ran it on and what broke.
- **Star and share the repo.** Reach is the bottleneck, not code.
